win_system.notes:
WAYS TO WIN

 The specified requirements for a winning combination in the base game are also used during bonus features or free spins play unless otherwise stated. Each wager is eligible for all winning combinations unless otherwise stated.

 You win if matching symbols appear along one of the following predefined lines on adjacent reels from left to right, starting with the leftmost reel. The number of possible lines in this game is 20. Please consult the paytable for the number of each symbol

wilds.name: REVEALING MIGHTY MYSTERY MASKS
wilds.behavior:
The Mystery Mask symbol reveals either a paying symbol or a Wild symbol.

 All landed Mystery Mask symbols in a spin reveal the same symbol. Land Mystery Mask symbols on three reels or more to spread them downwards to the bottom of their respective reels.

wilds.name: NUDGE YOUR MULTIPLIER WHEEL WITH NUDGEREELS™
wilds.behavior:
Land the Nudge Wild symbol to trigger the NUDGEREELS™ feature and nudge the Multiplier Wheel up to 50 times!

 If the Nudge Wild symbol lands with at least one winning combination on the reels it will activate the Multiplier Wheel next to the grid. The Multiplier Wheel will spin to a multiplier value that will be applied to the total of all wins on the current spin. The Nudge Wild symbol can also land with a nudge value displayed on it, in which case the Multiplier Wheel will also nudge the number of times shown on the symbol while adding all multiplier values it nudges to onto the total multiplier above the Wheel before applying the multiplier to the current total win.

 Possible nudge values on the Nudge Wild symbol: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 10, 25, 50

 Possible multiplier values on the Multiplier Wheel: 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 10x, 15x, 20x, 25x, 50x, 100x

modes.name: SERENGETI SUNSET BONUS FEATURE
modes.trigger: Land 3 FS scatter symbols to start this feature with 10 spins.
modes.effects:
Land at least 3 FS scatter symbols at the same time in the base game to activate this bonus feature. In this feature there are more Mystery Mask and Nudge Wild symbols compared to the base game.

 Land 3 FS scatter symbols to start this feature with 10 spins.

 Land 4 FS scatter symbols to start this feature with 12 spins.

 Land 5 FS scatter symbols to start this feature with 14 spins.

 Land additional FS scatter symbols at the same time within the feature and get additional spins.

 2 FS scatter symbols will award you 2 extra free spins.

 3 FS scatter symbols will award you 4 extra free spins.

 SPECIAL SYMBOLS

 The Wild and Nudge Wild symbols substitute for all symbols in the paytable.
